camel_example: aliyun ebs CreateDedicatedBlockStorageCluster --region cn-hangzhou --Azone 'cn-heyuan-b' --Type Premium --Capacity 61440 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DbscName myDBSCCluster
description_en: Creates a dedicated block storage cluster by calling the CreateDedicatedBlockStorageCluster operation with parameters such as Azone, Capacity, Type, and PeriodUnit
description_zh: 调用CreateDedicatedBlockStorageCluster接口，并指定Azone、Capacity、Type、PeriodUnit等参数，创建专属块存储集群
kebab_example: aliyun ebs create-dedicated-block-storage-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --azone cn-heyuan-b --dbsc-name myDBSCCluster --capacity 61440 --type Premium --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDedicatedBlockStorageCluster

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the dedicated block storage cluster. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 专属块存储集群所属地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the dedicated block storage cluster. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25610.html to query the zone list
parameters.help_zh: 专属块存储集群所属可用区ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25610.html获取可用区列表
parameters.name: azone

parameters.help_en: The name of the dedicated block storage cluster
parameters.name: dbsc_name

parameters.help_en:
The capacity of the dedicated block storage cluster. Valid values: 61440 to 2334720 GiB (2280 TiB). Minimum increment: 12288 GiB.

When the capacity of the dedicated block storage cluster is less than 576 TiB, the maximum throughput per TiB does not exceed 52 MB/s. When the capacity of the dedicated block storage cluster is greater than 576 TiB, the maximum throughput per TiB does not exceed 26 MB/s
parameters.help_zh:
专属块存储集群的容量。取值范围为61440~2334720GiB（2280 TiB），最小递增步长为12288 GiB。

当专属块存储集群的容量小于576 TiB时，每TiB支持的最大吞吐量性能不超过52 MB/s。当专属块存储集群的容量大于576 TiB时，每TiB支持的最大吞吐量性能不超过26 MB/s
parameters.name: capacity

parameters.help_en:
The performance type of the dedicated block storage cluster. Valid values:

Standard: basic. You can create PL0 ESSDs in this type of dedicated block storage cluster.
Premium: performance. You can create PL1 ESSDs in this type of dedicated block storage cluster.

Default value: Premium.

For more information about standard SSDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.help_zh:
专属块存储集群性能类型。取值范围：

Standard：基础型。该类型的专属块存储集群中可创建ESSD PL0云盘。
Premium：性能型。该类型的专属块存储集群中可创建ESSD PL1云盘。

默认值：Premium。

关于ESSD云盘的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the dedicated block storage cluster belongs
parameters.help_zh: 专属块存储集群所在的企业资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The tag key of the dedicated block storage cluster
fields.help_zh: 专属块存储集群的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the dedicated block storage cluster
fields.help_zh: 专属块存储集群的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values: 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 24, and 36
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration specified by the `Period` parameter. Only Month is supported
parameters.help_zh: 包年包月时长的时间单位，即参数`Period`的单位，目前仅支持Month
parameters.name: period_unit

DbscId.description_en: The ID of the dedicated block storage cluster
